# VELO_CITI

> Urban technical streetwear store: limited drops, technical fabrics and worldwide delivery. A portfolio project, a full-stack e-commerce app built with Spring Boot and React.

## Home

- [Home](/): Featured drops, sales and best sellers.

## Authentication

- [Create account](/register): Register a customer account.
- [Sign in](/login): Sign in to an existing account.

## Shop

- [Shop](/shop): Browse the full catalog, filter by category and sort by recency, price, discount, rating or best sellers.
- [Search](/search): Search products by name.

## Information

- [About](/about): The brand and what it stands for.
- [FAQ](/faq): Answers about orders, shipping and returns.
- [Return policy](/returns): Items can be returned within 14 days of delivery.
- [Terms and conditions](/terms): Terms of use of the store.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy): How personal data is handled.
